notes.subject: אוב
notes.rationale: אוב: man i save mumul (bel ples bilong win), o 'spirit bilong man i ded' — ol tanim tok i daraun

notes.subject: man i save mumul
notes.rationale: אוב em i man i save krai-krai tok wantaim voes i go daun — tasol 'mumul' i holim piksa bilong tok

notes.subject: tok i kamap long das
notes.rationale: Tok bilong taun i go daun olgeta, i kamap olsem olgeta win i singaut stret stret — piksa bilong lukluk i stap hait

translation: Na bai yu go daun olgeta, long graun yu bai toktok, na long das yu bai karim daun tok bilong yu; na bai voes bilong yu i kamap olsem bilong man i save mumul, long graun, na long das tok bilong yu bai i save singaut olsem liklik pisin.
